text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
All right, Air Shakur,
do a lap for me using
the strategy I just
explained.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I've once again come to the
training course to watch
the racers. That's
when I spot a trainer talking to Air
Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hrrraugh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eek! N-no way... Let's run somewhere
else...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's run is wilder than I
imagined... but it's not sloppy. In fact,
I'd say it's
refined to the point where no inefficiency
remains.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she enters the straightaway, she goes
faster and faster, like she's chasing her
prey.
I'm awestruck by the skill on display.
She's clearly talented. However...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: H-hey! What do you think you're doing? That is not what I told you to do!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I told you to try pace chasing for this
first
lap, so why did you hold
back until the
fourth corner?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to be your trainer, I need to
assess your skills. But I can't
do that unless
you cooperate!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then don't waste my time.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You need to see me pace chase to assess
my abilities? Why? What's
the logic there?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not that it matters.
I've already collected
and assessed the data myself. I'm not
gonna waste resources on half-baked
experiments.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But you can't guarantee that the data
you've collected is correct,
right? My
experience as a trainer affords me the
insight to make—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, okay, we're done. You're the same as
all the others, so forget I
ever agreed to
this training supervision thing. Leave.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What are you saying?! We just got
started!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And now we're done. If you try and take up any more of my precious time... You know what'll happen, right? Right?!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Urk! Wh-what's your problem... Fine, have
it your way!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
D-did you see that? How the heck are you
supposed to train such an unruly
racer?

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
You don't, that's how... Talking to her
would be like talking to a brick wa—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you're gonna whisper,
at least do it
where I can't—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hwaaah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Owww... I'm so sorry... Look at me, making
you help me up again...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Another spectacular fall. What happened
this time?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, well... I guess I went a little
overboard... My time hasn't gotten any
shorter recently...
I suppose I was running
too much...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...So you've hit a wall.
Instead of tackling it
head-on, wouldn't it be
better to try
something else?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I get that you're working hard,
but you can only improve so much. We
all have limits.
Refusing to give up will just result in
wasted time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I'm not very clever,
so any idea
I have would be
worthless... All I can do is
work hard.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But I figured that as long as I keep
throwing my whole body into that wall...
maybe someday,
it'll finally break? I don't
know...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Well,
then I guess... I look forward
to seeing you tear down
that wall.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Someday," huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What a meaningless wish...

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Phew... Looks like she's calmed down... That Air Shakur, she was even worse than usual today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said it rather quietly,
but the pain in
her voice echoes through my
mind...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But so does the image of her run. Later in
the evening, I find myself
back at the
course, only to see...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dammit... nothing changed! Not now, not then, NOT EVER!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Seven centimeters! That's it! Just a few
centimeters, but no matter
how much I
try... I can't even—

Oh my,
this isn't like her at all. All that
bottled up frustration is finally
spilling out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good evening. I am Agnes Tachyon, a
friend of Shakur's... Although
I'm sure
she'd object to that statement.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She's certainly overdoing it today. For
someone so obsessed with efficiency and
benefit, seeing her lashing out so
fruitlessly is quite
strange.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Do you have much experience with the
world of zeros and ones? If
not, I'm afraid
you may never understand her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You could say... Shakur is a devout
follower of data. She spends her time
collecting it and running simulations,
all in the hopes of finding a
solution.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She sees the world in terms of true and
false. Ambiguities such as
potential do not
exist for her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What you see now... is her god denying her
a prosperous future. And
as her god is
absolute, that revelation too remains
unchangeable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If it did change, that would mean her
entire worldview is wrong—an equally
terrifying prospect. So she has no choice
but to accept her
fate, whether she likes it or not.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, correct you are! Her mind truly is an
enigma. Why does she
continue to
struggle when she herself would admit it's
futile?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Shakur's vision of the ideal racer is
chiseled perfection... But if you ask me,
there is potential to be found in the
discarded scraps and
undefined spaces.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my,
it looks like she's finishing up. As
much as she likes observing
other runners,
she hates to be the one observed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I shall be taking my leave here, but you... Now that your curiosity has been piqued and Shakur fills your thoughts... What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if in response to Agnes Tachyon's
question, I turn around and race
after Air
Shakur.
